evidence.finding: The complete product API exposes work/project views and plan updates, sessions, workspaces, panes, worktrees, events and plugins. No native external issue sync, task hierarchy, billing, organization roles, deployment or PR operations occur in this method surface.

evidence.title: Herduck src/cli/spec.rs
evidence.finding: The herduck CLI routes work plan, overview and follow-up plus pane/agent/session/worktree operations to the shared local API.

evidence.title: Herduck src/projects/catalog/topic_cover.rs
evidence.finding: SQLite stores authored goal/next_steps/blocker under stable topic key. Transactional update supports expected_updated_at conflicts; model regrouping keeps cover-only topics. Only latest cover is stored, not a revision history.

evidence.title: Herduck src/projects/cover.rs
evidence.finding: Authored Work plan has goal, up to3 next steps, blocker note and timestamp. blocked_session_ref is reserved absent. There are no parent/child, acceptance-gate, task-state, owner or approval fields.

evidence.title: Herduck src/projects/overview.rs
evidence.finding: The shared view has needs-input/working/ready/paused/open/history counts and session evidence. Suggestions bind an ID to evidence and require explicit Continue; idle/history are not completion.

evidence.title: Herduck src/app/project_followup.rs
evidence.finding: Follow-up checks exact current suggestion, reuses matching original runtime or resumes its native conversation, waits for confirmed original agent idle, cancels replaced targets, and caps16 pending/128 retained records in server memory.

evidence.title: Herduck src/projects/adapters.rs
evidence.finding: Five native history adapters: Codex, Claude, Pi, OpenCode and Grok. Bounded file/depth/JSON scans import metadata and references, not an external issue tracker; parse failures are isolated.

evidence.title: Herduck src/projects/transcript.rs
evidence.locator: read_transcript; read_full_transcript; collector limits; backend dispatch
evidence.finding: Local readable transcript paths support Claude/Codex/Pi/Grok; OpenCode indexing does not provide readable transcript preview. Preview caps500 messages and4000 characters per message; full-message cap8MiB.

evidence.title: Herduck src/projects/domain.rs
evidence.finding: Stable keys derive from backend and canonical session identity. Semantic grouping fingerprint includes title/cwd/backend; topic keys normalize labels. Allowed-root and ID validation constrain history references.

evidence.title: Herduck src/api/server.rs
evidence.finding: API is local socket with0600 permissions, request-size and timeout bounds. It is a single-OS-user boundary rather than team identities or scoped project roles.

evidence.title: Herduck src/terminal/runtime.rs
evidence.finding: Native terminal runtime delegates PTY process creation, input, visible/recent text and shutdown to PaneRuntime. Ordinary local shell/agent processes are not isolated containers or VMs.

evidence.title: Herduck src/persist/restore.rs
evidence.finding: Normal restore reconstructs layout and fresh shells in saved working directories with supported native-agent resume plans; live handoff has a separate inherited-runtime path. This is not arbitrary process checkpoint restoration.

evidence.title: Herduck src/persist/io.rs
evidence.finding: Local session.json/session-history.json snapshots use temporary-file rename; clearing deletes those files. No immutable audit log or hosted-history replication is implemented here.

evidence.title: Herduck src/remote/unix.rs
evidence.finding: Inherited SSH thin-client launcher is disabled in this revision. Its presence in source does not make remote provisioning an accessible Herduck feature.

evidence.title: Herduck src/config/model.rs
evidence.locator: UpdateConfig defaults; ProjectsSummaryConfig and provider settings
evidence.finding: Automatic version/manifest checks default false. Summary generation is configured separately, defaults off, supports explicit provider chains and environment-key names.

evidence.title: Herduck src/projects/semantic.rs
evidence.finding: Opt-in summary provider sends selected prompt to configured HTTP endpoint with optional bearer key from environment, timeout and status handling; quota/model errors drive fallback. This is model traffic, not telemetry collection.

evidence.title: Herduck src/logging.rs

evidence.title: Herduck src/update.rs

evidence.title: Herduck src/worktree.rs
